intended_object: One chosen solution, for each n, of the n-th regularized (mollified) Euler evolution. It starts from the divergence-free initial field A and lives on the time interval [0, regularizedTime A]. It is an approximate solution used in the compactness/limit argument for local existence of the Euler equations (from the docstring and its uses in OrdinaryEulerLocalExistence.lean).
explanation: The body is just `Classical.choose` applied to the existence lemma `(regularizer n).exists_smooth`. It picks one witness of a `RegularizedEvolution`, so that later lemmas can refer to it: `regularizedSolution_initial`, `regularizedSolution_bounds` and `regularizedSolution_cauchy`, which feed `localLimit` and then the local evolution. It does not define a canonical mathematical notion; it is an arbitrary choice of approximate solutions made inside the local-existence proof. Its docstring says only that it is this choice. So it is a technical device of the proof with no standalone counterpart in the literature, and there is no Mathlib counterpart.
